@graph.headline: How to Use Help Scout: Setup and Workflows

mainEntity.name: Can I use Help Scout with Gmail?

acceptedAnswer.text: Help Scout can connect a support email address through its email setup and forwarding process. Test inbound and outbound messages before switching the public support address.

mainEntity.name: Can I create more than one inbox?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but the number included depends on the plan. The current pricing page lists one on Free, two on Standard, five on Plus, and ten on Pro.

mainEntity.name: Does Help Scout import knowledge base articles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The standard import tool does not import help center articles. Help Scout points to the Docs API for a custom knowledge-base transfer.
Workflows can automate actions, and the pricing page lists round-robin routing on Plus and balanced routing on Pro.

mainEntity.name: Can I export conversation threads to CSV?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selected reports can be exported as CSV or XLSX, but conversation thread contents are excluded. Other conversation data is obtained through the Inbox API.
